description: Upcoming public comedy events on JokeStack, anywhere in the world: stand-up, improv and storytelling shows and open mics. Use it for questions like 'open mics in Kraków this week' or 'improv in Warsaw this month'. Returns each event's title, date and time, venue, city, kind and public link. For one event's description and organizer, call jokestack_get_event. For regular nights that aren't tied to a date, use jokestack_search_scenes.

cursor.description: From a previous result's 'More results' line, for the next page.

days.description: Only events starting within this many days from now.

language.description: Language for city names and links: 'pl' for jokestack.pl, 'en' for the English site. Defaults to the site that was called.

open_mic_only.description: Only open mics and open stages, where new performers can sign up.

place.description: A city, region or address anywhere, e.g. 'Kraków', 'Berlin', 'Małopolska', 'Piotrkowska 120, Łódź'. Polish voivodeships are known by name; other places are looked up on the map. Leave out to search everywhere.

radius_km.description: How far from the place, in kilometres. Ignored for a voivodeship.

name: jokestack_search_events
title: Search comedy events
